title: Etalon: Holistic Performance Evaluation Framework for LLM Inference Systems
authors: Amey Agrawal; Anmol Agrawal; Nitin Kedia; Jayashree Mohan; Souvik Kundu; Nipun Kwatra; Ramachandran Ramjee; Alexey Tumanov
affiliations: Georgia Institute of Technology, Microsoft Research India, Intel AI Lab

problem_statement.en: Conventional LLM serving metrics (TTFT, TBT, TPOT, normalised latency) fail to capture user-facing experience in real-time streaming applications. TPOT and normalised latency hide intermittent decode stalls by averaging over many tokens; TBT CDFs reveal tail spikes but not their per-request frequency or temporal position; TBT also miscounts non-uniform generators such as speculative decoding. The result is an inability to define a single SLO that reflects glitch-free user experience.
problem_statement.zh: 既有 LLM 服務評估指標（TTFT、TBT、TPOT、normalised latency）無法完整刻畫即時串流應用下的使用者體驗。TPOT 與 normalised latency 因平均掉大量 token，掩蓋了 decode 過程中的間歇性 stall；TBT CDF 雖能呈現 tail 尖峰，卻無法呈現其在單一請求中的發生頻率與時間位置；TBT 亦無法正確處理如 speculative decoding 等非均勻產生 token 的策略。導致業界難以定義一個能反映「無卡頓使用者體驗」的單一 SLO。

key_innovation.en: Two complementary user-centric metrics. fluidity-index: a deadline-based metric where each token i has deadline D_i = D_p + i*D_d; slack accumulates from early tokens and is reset on a miss; the metric reports the fraction of deadlines met per request. fluid token generation rate: the maximum sustainable throughput such that >=99% of requests achieve fluidity-index >= 0.9. Both are black-box and apply to any API endpoint, enabling apples-to-apples comparison across open-source and proprietary services.
key_innovation.zh: 提出兩項互補、以使用者為中心的指標。fluidity-index：以 deadline 為基礎的指標，第 i 個 token 的 deadline 為 D_i = D_p + i*D_d；提早產生的 token 形成 slack 並可累積、遇 miss 時清空；指標回報每筆請求中達標 deadline 的比例。fluid token generation rate：在 >=99% 請求達 fluidity-index >= 0.9 的條件下，系統可持續維持的最大吞吐量。兩者皆為 black-box，可套用於任意 API endpoint，使開源系統與專有服務得以對等比較。

baselines_compared: TTFT, TBT, TPOT, normalised latency; vLLM, Sarathi-Serve, Anyscale, Groq, Fireworks

key_improvements.en: Quantifies that vLLM suffers 3x worse tail-TBT throughput than Sarathi-Serve under chunked-prefill, a gap hidden by TPOT-based metrics. Reveals Groq tail-TBT is 4x worse than its TPOT-implied throughput suggests. At 25 ms target TBT, fluidity-index-based capacity for Llama3-8B on H100 is ~0.6 QPS for both vLLM and Sarathi-Serve, with vLLM exhibiting higher deadline-miss rate at lower percentiles.
key_improvements.zh: 量化指出在 chunked-prefill 條件下，vLLM 的 tail-TBT 吞吐量比 Sarathi-Serve 差 3x，此差距為 TPOT-based 指標所掩蓋；亦揭示 Groq 的 tail-TBT 比其 TPOT 推估值差 4x。在 25 ms target TBT、Llama3-8B 於 H100 設定下，fluidity-index 容量於 vLLM 與 Sarathi-Serve 皆約為 0.6 QPS，但 vLLM 在低百分位的 deadline-miss rate 較高。

reported_accuracy: Not Reported (black-box; not a predictive model)
validation_workloads: Arxiv-Summarization, LMSys-Chat-1M, custom prompts (256-8k tokens) against Anyscale/Groq/Fireworks

scope_assumptions.en: Black-box: not a generative latency model — Etalon measures, it does not predict. Prefill-deadline D_p must be calibrated per system by profiling prefill time as a function of input length (vLLM used as reference). A small empirical scheduling-slack term SD is required and is left to user choice; no auto-tuning. Decode targets D_d are pre-set (25 ms strict, 50 ms medium, 100 ms relaxed). Does not auto-tune system knobs (chunk size, block size). API-only proprietary systems cannot expose prefill-only timing, so prefill SLO calibration is approximate for them.
scope_assumptions.zh: Black-box；不是延遲生成模型 — Etalon 為量測而非預測。Prefill deadline D_p 需依各系統 profile prefill time 對 prompt length 的曲線單獨校準（論文以 vLLM 作為 reference）。需設定一小段經驗性的 scheduling-slack SD，由使用者決定，未提供自動化調整。Decode 目標 D_d 為預設值（25 ms 嚴格、50 ms 中等、100 ms 寬鬆）。不自動調整系統參數（chunk size、block size）。對僅提供 API 的專有系統，因無法觀測純 prefill 時間，prefill SLO 校準屬近似。
